decisions.decision: Refurbish a returned item only when it can be leased again and its price after the work is more than the work costs; otherwise retire it rather than refurbish at a loss.

Match a second-life item to waiting-list entries whose minimum condition, deadline, financeable preferred term and net budget at that term all fit, using the condition after refurbishment; the earliest needed-by date wins and, on the same date, whoever signed up first wins, so the result is deterministic and explainable.

Show an item passport on used items' product pages with every life's dates, term, starting condition and outcome but never who leased it, and count CO₂ avoided per reuse life as manufacturing CO₂ minus the refurbishment share, scaled by the condition the life started in.
